title: Agency obligations
lead: Record supplied partner terms, property photography and completed-Case review evidence. Actual terms, access, rights and consent remain human inputs.
photoLead: Schedule property preparation without a buyer Case. Completion gives no media rights or permission to publish.
held: Held — missing, changed or expired evidence
qualified: A currently qualified human reviews exact source and acceptance. Recording creates no invoice, settlement or legal terms.
noDocument: Supplied terms text is the source
sourceHint: Transcribe the actual terms exactly. Supply their actual reference and version; do not generate missing clauses or fees.
reviewHint: First prepare and qualify a Bulgarian CMS Review: title is the consented public name or the anonymous review heading; first paragraph is exact review text, second is the exact verification statement. The author then grants or refuses separate consent.
policyHeld: The current review-consent policy is unavailable. Positive client consent stays held; use the approved manual consent procedure and reviewed evidence.
manual: Use the agency’s approved manual procedure and retain its exact evidence.
reviewed: I checked this exact source, scope and action.
scopeReviewed: I checked this property, supplied photography scope and manual access path. Media rights remain separate.
statusMissing: No recorded outcome. Keep the same action key and check again before retrying.
failed: The action was not applied. Review current evidence and access.
pending: The action is unresolved. Reconcile it before submitting another key.
limited: Only the permitted first 50 records are shown. Open the relevant Case or contact for a focused entry.
privacy: Private evidence; no customer contact details are displayed publicly.

fields.professionalName: Qualified person responsible for the review
fields.photographyScope: Actual photography scope and access dependency

name: Exact consented public name
photoRequested: Photography request recorded; propose and review a time in the appointment workbench.
publicationSeparate: Publication remains a separate CMS decision.
author: Recorded review author
historyRecent: Recent decisions · up to 50 permitted entries
photoBoundary: Scheduling and media rights are reviewed separately.
photoArrangeHint: Check the current host, property access, service hours and external calendars before committing the time.
termsReviewed: I reviewed this exact supplied source and will be its accountable owner.
stepUp: Confirm your identity to apply this change. Your draft is retained.
